source_native_structure.effort: one standardized observation hour per study site and sampling day, as source Methods define
source_native_structure.pair_meaning: README defines InsectPlantPair as one specific insect species interacting with one specific plant species and Abundance as the frequency observed in a study site and sampling day

partner_identity_reconstruction.purpose: recover the primary pollinator identity required by the frozen analysis plan while aggregating across plant partners
partner_identity_reconstruction.initial_insect_vocabulary: all source-native InSpecies values from Insect_Abundance
partner_identity_reconstruction.initial_plant_vocabulary: all source-native PlSpecies values from IndividualPlants_Abundance
algorithm: For each unsplit InsectPlantPair in deterministic lexical order, first choose the unique longest currently known plant-name suffix when available; the preceding string is the insect identity.
If no plant suffix is available, choose the unique longest currently known insect-name prefix; the remaining string is the plant identity.
Add newly recovered insect or plant identities to the corresponding source-derived vocabulary and repeat passes until no unsplit pair remains.
Fail rather than guess if a longest match is not unique or any pair remains unresolved.
partner_identity_reconstruction.taxonomy_policy: source strings are preserved after whitespace trimming only; no external taxonomy, fuzzy matching, synonymization or outcome-dependent alias merging is used

decision.reason: Nineteen stable Mallorca local communities meet the frozen temporal, identity, quantitative-interaction and effort requirements before any natural-regime coordinate is opened.

claim_boundaries: The 19 localities are systems within one independent source study, not 19 independent studies.
EsCabanells is excluded solely by the predeclared six-bin floor.
No source is selected or excluded using D1, phi, rho_eq or journal-route results.
No reproductive or performance outcome is used for admission.
Natural breadth is not mapped literally onto synthetic k.
